positioning: Simple systems for real estate, property, and housing businesses

private_owner_inbox.authentication: desktop launcher exchanges a private bearer token for a short-lived signed access ticket; browser then uses a secure Flask session

visual_design: Premium ivory + navy + sage design retained. Version 3.8.0 adds larger everyday text, fewer micro-labels, simpler public wording, fewer competing CTAs, and older-user-friendly readability while preserving the compact 3.7 composition.

template_library_foundation.first_flagship_recommendation: Completed: three independent working systems are published and customizable

completed_systems.name: Student Housing Matching and Placement System
completed_systems.truth_note: Independent portfolio project based on market research; no commission, adoption, affiliation, or endorsement claim.

public_portfolio.truth_boundary: Built by Key Castro; no client commission, adoption, or paid engagement is claimed without evidence.

information_architecture.ux_contract: Short, simple, clear public content. No unnecessary repetition. One clear purpose per page.
information_architecture.visitor_flow: Home -> Systems -> System -> Contact, with How It Works explaining the build process and the two post-build management choices.
information_architecture.presentation_contract: One main job per page: Home explains the offer; Systems shows existing systems; each System page explains that system; How It Works explains the business process and management choices; Contact collects one inquiry.

system_search.implementation: client-side progressive enhancement over server-rendered system cards

commercial_model.development_pricing: Quoted separately based on requirements; it is not included in managed-maintenance pricing.
commercial_model.full_handover: I build it. You manage it. Client is responsible for ongoing hosting, domain, backups, maintenance, updates, infrastructure accounts, and future technical management after handover.
commercial_model.managed_by_key_castro: I build it. I manage it. KEY CASTRO continues the agreed technical management under monthly or yearly managed maintenance.
commercial_model.plan_selection: monthly/yearly plan keys are resolved server-side; official managed-maintenance price text is generated from trusted pricing metadata; no checkout is implied
commercial_model.legacy_compatibility: legacy subscribe/free-access URLs and old stored subscription labels are accepted only for compatibility and normalize/display as Managed by KEY CASTRO

ux_simplification_3_5.pricing_location: system detail pages and plan-specific Contact context

focus: clear visual separation between system choices
subtle warm identity for Property Operations Command Center
subtle cool identity for Property Inventory Hub
clear borders, spacing, hover and focus states

business_model_3_6.managed_maintenance_price_meaning: ongoing managed technical service only; development/customization is separately quoted

release_workflow.default: one-command update + tests + Git pushes + Render deploy + live verification
release_workflow.success_condition: production health reports version 3.8.2; live How It Works shows exactly two numbered steps, the existing-system adaptation sentence, balanced View Systems and Request a System buttons in Step 1, no final Want to get started CTA, and the live Systems page contains Student Housing Matching and Placement System plus exactly 3 published system cards

ux_master_refinement_3_7.search_behavior: metadata search remains implemented but is hidden while the public catalog has 6 or fewer systems

human_clarity_3_8.public_navigation_label_change: Services -> How It Works; canonical /services route preserved
human_clarity_3_8.primary_test: first-time non-technical older visitor can understand the basic offer without learning internal terminology
